claims.statement: The global energy and Poynting momentum reported by the periodic Maxwell reference agree with direct integration of an independently constructed electromagnetic stress-energy tensor.
nonclaims: Agreement between two implemented diagnostics does not establish physical completeness of a plasma model.

claims.statement: Bounded deterministic tests require field-only four-momentum closure over long vacuum propagation, characteristic energy-momentum reconstruction, source-work closure of the time component, and rejection of invented external four-impulse.
nonclaims: The prescribed-current case does not close a self-consistent particle plus field spatial momentum ledger.
The result is not plasma-wing thrust or propulsion evidence.
